ally: {ally} answers the call of {leader}: some {n} of its warriors march with {name} on {town}.

absorbText.undead: {leader} falls on {other} and raises its fallen as its own. {name} marches with their corpses now.
absorbText.cult: The choir of {name} sings over the dead of {other}, and they get up and join the hymn.
absorbText.tribe: {leader} breaks {other} and makes its warriors swear to the horde, or die. Most swear.

deeds.clash: the town's part in the battle at {where}

vengeance.vow: Word comes back from {seat}: {leader} has sworn {town} will pay for {deed}.

clash.announce: Scouts say {a} and {b} are both gathering toward {where}. Their hosts will meet there in {days} days. {town} can ride out and fall on one of them while it fights the other, or keep behind its walls.
clash.fought: {winner} and {loser} meet in battle at {where}. {winner} holds the field; {loser} drags its wounded home.
clash.swallowed: {winner} breaks {loser} at {where} and takes its warriors. Whatever {loser} was brewing, {winner} brews now.
clash.joined: {town}'s heroes and the watch ride out to {where} and fall on {target} from the flank while it fights {other}.
clash.pact: {a} and {b} come to the walls of {town} together. The two hosts have made common cause.
clash.melee: {a} and {b} reach the walls of {town} within days of each other and turn on one another before the gates. {winner} drives {loser} off and comes on, bloodied.

burn.landed: Fire in the night: {by} set {where} alight. By morning it is a shell, and {owner} must rebuild.
burn.stopped: Someone tried to fire {where} in the night. {guard} caught the torches before the thatch took.

assassinate.landed: At dawn {victim} is found dead, a black feather on the pillow. Everyone knows whose sign it is: {by}.
assassinate.stopped: An assassin of {by} came in the night for {victim}. {guard} got there first.

walls.landed: Agents of {by} have been at the walls: mortar picked out, a gate bar sawn half through. The masons say it will be weeks before the defences are whole.
walls.stopped: The watch catches a stranger with a mason's chisel at the foot of the walls. Under the lash he names {by}.

treasury.landed: {gold} gold is gone from the treasury overnight. The clerk who kept the keys is gone too, and the trail leads toward {seat}.
treasury.stopped: A clerk is caught carrying the treasury's ledgers out of the town hall at midnight. Paid by {by}, he says.

stores.landed: Rot in the granaries: someone of {by} has fouled the stores. A third of the town's food goes to the midden.
stores.stopped: A watchman finds a sack of blackrot spores by the granary door, and the man who dropped it running for the gate.

discord.landed: Pamphlets and whispers of {by} set the wards against each other. The council is shouted down in its own hall.
discord.stopped: The watch traces the poisonous pamphlets to a printer in the pay of {by} and breaks his press.

dead.landed: The graves of {town} open at night and the dead walk the lanes. {victims} do not live to see morning.
dead.stopped: The dead come up out of the burying ground and the watch and {guard} put them back in it before dawn.

terror.landed: Every dog in {town} howls at once at midnight, and every child dreams the same dream of {leader}. Nobody sleeps.

tribe.name: the Great Horde
tribe.what: Every band in the hills is gathering under one banner to break the walls.
tribe.start: War drums in every valley at once. {leader} has called every band within a month's march, and they are coming: {name}'s crisis has begun, the Great Horde.
tribe.phase: The Great Horde swells. Bands the town has never heard of stream past the ruined farms toward {seat}.
tribe.culminate: The Great Horde is on the move. Every spear {leader} could gather marches on {town} at once.
tribe.averted: With {leader} broken, the Great Horde falls apart into quarrelling bands before it ever marches.

undead.name: the Long Dark
undead.what: The dead of every barrow are waking, and they hunger for the living town.
undead.start: The bells of {town} ring by themselves at midnight. In every barrow from here to {seat} the dead are stirring: {name}'s crisis has begun, the Long Dark.
undead.phase: The Long Dark deepens. Days grow short and grey, and the dead walk even at noon near {seat}.
undead.culminate: The Long Dark falls. {leader} leads every corpse in {region} against the walls of {town}.
undead.averted: With {leader} gone, the dead lie down again in their barrows, and the Long Dark lifts.

dragon.name: Wyrmfire
dragon.what: It means to burn the town street by street until it kneels or is ash.
dragon.start: A shadow crosses the sun over {town} and does not stop. {leader} has decided the town is its to burn: Wyrmfire has begun.
dragon.phase: Wyrmfire grows. Farms burn every week now, and the drakes of {seat} hunt the roads.
dragon.culminate: {leader} comes for {town} with every drake and tithe-taker it commands, and the sky over the walls turns red.
dragon.averted: {leader} is laid low, and the fires go out across the land. Wyrmfire is over.

schemers.name: the Night of Knives
schemers.what: Its agents are inside the walls, buying clerks, poisoning wells and killing councillors.
schemers.start: A councillor's dog is found strangled with a silk cord, and a note: soon. {leader}'s agents are inside {town}: the Night of Knives has begun.
schemers.phase: The Night of Knives draws closer. Nobody in the council trusts anybody, and doors are barred at dusk.
schemers.culminate: The Night of Knives: {leader}'s agents strike everywhere at once, and {name} marches on the walls to finish the work.
schemers.averted: With {leader} fallen, its agents scatter and the Night of Knives never comes.

beasts.name: the Devouring
beasts.what: It is driving every hungry thing in the wilds toward the town's fields.
beasts.start: The herds come down out of {region} in a panic, and something worse comes after them. {leader} is hungry: the Devouring has begun.
beasts.phase: The Devouring spreads. Fields are trampled flat and whole flocks vanish in a night.
beasts.culminate: {leader} drives every beast of {region} down on {town} in one great hunt.
beasts.averted: {leader} is dead, and the beasts of {region} scatter back into the wild. The Devouring is over.

rivals.name: the Usurpation
rivals.what: It means to take the town for itself: buy its council, break its trade, then march in.
rivals.start: Heralds in fine livery read a proclamation in the square: {leader} claims {town} by right of conquest. The Usurpation has begun.
rivals.phase: The Usurpation tightens its grip. Merchants are bought, and the roads to {town} answer to {leader}.
rivals.culminate: {leader} rides on {town} at the head of {name} to claim the town hall.
rivals.averted: {leader} is beaten, and the Usurpation dies with the claim.

cult.name: the Hollow Hymn
cult.what: Its choir is singing something old awake under the town.
cult.start: Everyone in {town} wakes humming the same slow tune. The choir of {name} has begun the Hollow Hymn.
cult.phase: The Hollow Hymn grows louder. Neighbours sing it in their sleep, and the graves are restless.
cult.culminate: The Hollow Hymn ends on its last note, and {name} comes up out of the ground against {town}.
cult.averted: The choir is silenced, and the Hollow Hymn is forgotten by morning.

ended.held: {town} holds against {crisis}. {name} limps away, its crisis spent.
ended.sacked: {crisis} has broken {town}. {name} goes home laden, and every other enemy in the land has seen it done.
ended.routed: {name}'s host is broken before it ever reaches the walls. {crisis} is spent.
